label: FP
reason: The XSS warning is a false positive because encodeForHTML() is called immediately before the PrintWriter.println() call, properly escaping all user-supplied content. The response-splitting warning is also a false positive because cookies are stored server-side and do not get rendered into the HTTP response body where split attacks would occur.

evidence.note: User input is passed through ESAPI encoder.encodeForHTML() before reaching the response writer
